title: Approved-delta guard refusals ask the human to approve under their own name
symptom: stage moves refused as native-delta-changed or as native-delta-unverifiable for a missing digest say: ask the human for a new scope approval (specsync change approve <id> --actor "<their name>")
trigger: An approved change whose delta is edited after approval, or whose definition approval has no approved_delta_digests, then chough stage advance
expected: The remedy names specsync change approve <id> --actor "<agent-account>" --note "Human authority: <source>; covered scope: <scope>; limits: <limits>", as lifecycle.md, plan.md and docs/cli.md say
actual: The remedy asks the human to approve and uses their name as the native actor
impact: Agents following the refusal either stop to ask the human to run a native command already covered by standing authority, or record a human name as the actor
source: Leif 2026-11-03 7:49 AM MT backlog item: contradictory recovery guidance

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Fixed in src/stage.rs: both remedies name the agent-account actor and the human authority note; the failure-first case passed after the fix
